qualification.details: Professor: Minimum 2nd Class Bachelor's Degree in concerned subject with at least 55% marks/equivalent OGPA. Minimum 2nd Class Master's Degree in the concerned subject with at least 55% marks/equivalent OGPA. Must have Ph.D. Degree in the concerned subject. Experience: Minimum of 10 years of experience (excluding Ph.D. study) in teaching/research/extension education not below the rank of Assistant Professor/Equivalent out of which 2 years must be in the cadre of Associate Professor/Equivalent in the 7th CPC pay scale of level 13A. Associate Director of Research: Minimum 2nd Class Bachelor's Degree in Agriculture with at least 55% marks/equivalent OGPA. Minimum 2nd Class Master's Degree in Agriculture in any subject of Agriculture Science with at least 55% marks. Ph.D. Degree in any subject of Agriculture Science. Experience: Minimum of 10 years of experience in teaching/research/extension education not below the rank of Assistant Professor/Equivalent out of which 2 years must be in the cadre of Associate Professor/Equivalent in 7th CPC pay scale of level 13A.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for OUAT Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: ouat.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 28-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Odisha University of Agriculture & Technology, Bhubaneswar (OUAT) for filling various faculty positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in OUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 52 vacancies available for Professor, Associate Director of Research, and equivalent positions across various departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of completed offline applications is 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted strictly in offline mode by sending the filled form via Speed Post or Registered Post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for OUAT Professor Recruitment?
faq.answer: All candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 1500/- through the designated bank account or Green Channel Counter.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 60 years as specified in the official notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary under Cell-1, Level-14 amounting to Rs. 1,44,200/- per month along with usual DA and other allowances.

faq.question: Q8. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree, Master's Degree in the concerned subject with at least 55% marks, and a Ph.D. degree along with relevant teaching or research experience.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: The completed application form along with necessary enclosures must be sent to the Registrar, OUAT, Bhubaneswar-751003, Odisha.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and application format directly from the official website ouat.ac.in or through the direct link provided in this article.
